bibliographic.title: Yee'Howdy
bibliographic.author: Charlie, Gabe, Zack, River
bibliographic.description: You are challenged to a duel that will take place in 24 hours. Follow the townsfolk's schedules to get items, and trade items for guns. Depending on your actions leading up to the duel and the gun you purchase, different results will occur. Discover what's up with the residents of Tumble Town in your adventure in Yee' Howdy!
